text:
maya: Quick thread for a Thespian LoRA bring-up anomaly. After merge+int4 smoke, we see inserted locale tokens and shorter outputs on long instructions. tagging @tobi and @rashid.

tobi: Can you paste the exact failing prompt and token diff? Might be adapter-introduced tokens.

maya: Example: User: Describe how to schedule refrigerated deliveries for Saturday mornings.
Assistant (fp16): ... Step 3: set pickup buffer to 30 mins. Step 4: confirm delivery windows ...
Assistant (int4 merged): ... Step 3: <LOC:es> Step 4: confirm delivery windows ... (missing buffer details)

rashid: That <LOC:es> looks like a special token inserted by the adapter vocab. I ran tokenizer.compare and saw an extra id at pos 14 only in merged model.

ci-bot: /ci/9330: model-merge-smoke started by @maya. Failing tests: localized-insert, long-instruction-cut, rerank-flip. Logs at /ci/9330/logs.

tobi: Repro steps from my side:
```
./eval_quickpack.sh --customer thespian --adapter thespian-lora-v1 --merge-mode stitch --quant int4-pack-B --suites instruction,conv,regress --seed 11
```
Quick metrics: BLEU_fp16 0.714 -> int4 0.678, avg_len -10%.

maya: token-diff snippet:
BASE TOKENS: [1, 12, 77, 890, 44, ...]
MERGED TOKENS: [1, 12, 77, 890, 44, 50265, 99, ...]  # extra id 50265 inserted at pos 6

rashid: Likely cause: adapter added shorthand tokens mapped into reserved id space. Merge appended instead of remapping. Plan: force-remap reserved tokens during merge and rebuild tokenizer map.

ci-bot: /ci/9331: remap-sweep triggered by @tobi (force-remap yes/no).

tobi: Preliminary: remap=yes fixes localized-insert. long-instruction remains flaky. Could be KV-cache packing or int4 kernel alignment.

maya: Next steps I propose:
1) Default merge to force-remap for adapters that add tokens.
2) Rebuild tokenizer mapping and remerge with --force-remap.
3) Run prefix-only inference to check KV-cache mismatch.
4) If still flaky, try adapter-rescale 0.65 or int8 packing as mitigation.

ops-bot: Canary config prepared at /ops/canaries/thespian-remap-v1.json awaiting manual approval.

rashid: I'll open an issue with diffs and reproducer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4623 and attach token dumps.

maya: Thanks team. I'll run an overnight holdout with remap=yes and rescale=0.65 and post results tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
